label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/surprise tribute in the great hall for day 1 at eighteen, with eight lanterns, two hundred fresh replacement feast loaves, and the innkeeper escorting the mayor. Builder, freight and innkeeper jointly organized it; baker knowingly supplied the confidential committee order and heard the surprise arrangements. The mayor later learned of a community hospitality gathering and accepted an invitation, but the jubilee/tribute details remained withheld. Secretary helped openly with scheduling and escort logistics without demonstrated knowledge of the hidden tribute; neighbour publicized the general invitation without demonstrated knowledge of it.
